title: The Button I Kept Avoiding

pre.en: How long did the PDF button take to make in the end?
pre.zh: 那个 PDF 按钮最后花了多长时间做完？

intro: 小陈跟大家讲自己拖了八个月的一个小按钮：用户要，组长等，他就是不动手。读的时候留意 ask、want、expect、tell 后面先接人、再接 to do：asked me to do it、wanted someone else to offer。结尾是一张「时间账单」。

sentences.en: So, this is a story about a button.
sentences.zh: 跟你们讲讲一个按钮的故事。

sentences.en: Last March, users kept asking us to add "Export to PDF", and Rachel asked me to do it.
sentences.zh: 去年三月，用户一直要我们加个「导出为 PDF」，Rachel 就让我来做。

sentences.en: It was a small, boring job, the kind I usually leave until Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 这活儿又小又无聊，就是我一般会拖到周五下午才干的那种。

sentences.en: I kept meaning to start it, but I never got round to it.
sentences.zh: 我一直想着要动手，可就是没顾上。

sentences.en: At every stand-up, I secretly wanted someone else to offer.
sentences.zh: 每次站会，我心里都盼着别人主动接过去。

sentences.en: Nobody did.
sentences.zh: 没一个人接。

sentences.en: Rachel expected me to finish it "next week".
sentences.zh: Rachel 等着我「下周」做完。

sentences.en: And she never made a fuss, which somehow made it worse.
sentences.zh: 她也从来没为这事说过什么，不知怎么的，这反而更难受。

sentences.en: She just told me to keep her posted.
sentences.zh: 她只是让我有进展就告诉她。

sentences.en: Anyway, the whole thing dragged on for eight months.
sentences.zh: 总之，这事就这么拖了八个月。

sentences.en: New features felt more exciting, and the button felt like a waste of time.
sentences.zh: 新功能做起来更带劲，这个按钮感觉就是浪费时间。

sentences.en: I even gave a presentation about next year's plans without mentioning it once.
sentences.zh: 我甚至做了一次明年计划的分享，从头到尾一次都没提它。

sentences.en: Then a user wrote, "Still waiting. Please don't keep us waiting until Christmas."
sentences.zh: 后来有个用户留言：「还在等。别让我们等到圣诞节啊。」

sentences.en: One rainy Sunday in November, there was nothing on TV.
sentences.zh: 十一月一个下雨的星期天，电视上没什么好看的。

sentences.en: Tom was away, so nobody could make me watch another cooking show.
sentences.zh: Tom 不在家，也就没人拉我再看一集烹饪节目了。

sentences.en: So I made a cup of tea and finally got on with it.
sentences.zh: 于是我泡了杯茶，终于动手干了。

sentences.en: I wanted to finish it once and for all.
sentences.zh: 我想一次把它彻底搞定。

sentences.en: My tea wasn't even cold when a perfect PDF came out.
sentences.zh: 茶还没凉，一份完美的 PDF 就导出来了。

sentences.en: Hold on, I thought.
sentences.zh: 等等，我心想。

sentences.en: Is that really it?
sentences.zh: 就这样？

sentences.en: I tested it three times, because I was sure I'd broken something by mistake.
sentences.zh: 我测了三遍，因为我总觉得自己不小心弄坏了什么。

sentences.en: Then I left a note on the ticket for Rachel: "Done. Sorry about the wait."
sentences.zh: 然后我在工单上给 Rachel 留了句话：「做完了。让你久等了。」

sentences.en: So, time spent avoiding it: eight months.
sentences.zh: 所以，躲着它的时间：八个月。

sentences.en: Time spent doing it: forty minutes.
sentences.zh: 做它的时间：四十分钟。

sentences.en: Time spent telling everyone about it since: two weeks, and counting.
sentences.zh: 之后逢人就讲这件事的时间：两个星期，还没完。

cards.note: 软件里把内容存成别的格式：export to PDF / Excel。另一个意思是「出口（货物）」。
to plan to do something many times but not actually do it
cards.tip: mean to do 是「打算做」，加上 keep 就是「老想着、老没做」，带一点愧疚。meaning 后面接 to do。
cards.example: I keep meaning to call my grandmother, but the week just goes.

cards.note: to finally do something that you have wanted or planned to do for a long time
cards.tip: 英式说 round，美式说 around；后面接名词或 doing：get round to answering emails。
cards.example: I finally got round to fixing the bike last weekend.

cards.note: 形容词是 secret；secretly hope / want 是「心里偷偷盼着」，嘴上不说。
单独用 offer 就是「主动说我来」；后面也能接 to do：offer to help。
to get too excited or worried about something, often in a noisy way
to keep telling someone the latest news about something
cards.tip: 人放中间：keep me / her posted；Rachel 不催，只说「有进展告诉我」。
cards.example: The client is still deciding — I'll keep you posted.

cards.note: to continue for longer than you want or expect
cards.tip: 主语是事情（会议、项目、谈判），不是人；常和 for + 时间连用。
cards.example: The meeting dragged on until seven.

cards.note: App 里能用的一项功能就是一个 feature：add a new feature 加新功能。平时也指「特点、特色」。
something that is not useful or does not give good results
cards.tip: a 不能丢；加强语气说 a complete / total waste of time。浪费钱是 a waste of money。
cards.example: That meeting was a complete waste of time.

cards.note: to talk to a group of people about a subject, often using slides
cards.tip: 关于什么用 about / on；给谁讲用 to：give a presentation to the team。
cards.example: I have to give a presentation to the client on Monday.

cards.note: mention sth 直接接宾语，不加 about：mention the problem，不说 mention about it。
to make someone wait, usually because you are late
英式也说 cookery programme；TV show 泛指电视节目。
to start or continue doing a job, especially after a delay
cards.tip: 英式口语，常带「别磨蹭了」的意思；和 get on with sb（和某人相处）同形，要看后面是事还是人。
cards.example: Stop talking and get on with your work!

cards.note: completely and finally, so that something does not happen or need doing again
cards.tip: 常放句尾，带一点「受够了」的语气；不要说 once for all。
cards.example: Let's fix this printer once and for all.

cards.note: used to ask someone to wait for a short time
cards.tip: 这里不是电话里的「别挂」，而是自己心里一愣：「等等……」。
cards.example: Hold on — I just need to find the link.

cards.note: without intending to, because of an error
to write a short message and put it somewhere for someone to find
